consequence.statement: When the CAInjectorMerging feature gate is enabled, the ca-injector will merge new CA certificates with existing ones instead of replacing them outright.

assertion.statement: The CAInjectorMerging feature gate is added to the ca-injector; when enabled, it changes behavior from replacing to merging CA certificates.
